Hi Sam / team — Dev here (SE). Thanks for the details, this is useful. I'll take the lead on the technical portion of the call on Tue 2/23. A couple quick notes and requests so we can make the demo actionable:

1) Call plan (30–45 min):
   - 10 min: high-level architecture + traffic profile review
   - 20–25 min: performance expectations, kernel/quantization options, batching strategy
   - 10 min: next steps (MAP + PoC plan)

2) Please upload the sample payload and a simple CSV with timestamps / rps distribution (steady + burst window). That helps us run quick spike tests in our staging env.

3) Attachments: I'm sharing a short onboarding MAP and a perf template you can populate: Dedicated_Onboarding_MAP.pdf; Perf_Template.csv

4) Load testing: We typically offer two options — we can provide a staging Dedicated endpoint under a short-lived eval agreement for Redwood-run tests, or you can run a client-side synthetic load test against a staging endpoint we provide. For this sizing (up to 1k burst) we will want to validate CPU/GPU utilization and KV cache hit rates.

5) Pre-demo ask: confirm whether you plan to use quantized weights (int8) or fp16; if you have model name/version we can pre-run a quick profiling pass.

I'll be on the Tue slot. Marissa / Aditya — can you send the calendar invite and include the meeting link + a copy of the MAP?

Cheers,
